business_summary: Zhejiang Jiaxin Silk Corp.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of silk products in China and internationally. It operates through Silk Apparel and Related Industries, Investment Properties and Related, Investment, and Financial Leasing and Pawnbroking segments. The company offers silk underwear, sleepwear and loungewear, cultural and creative gifts, home textiles, scarves, and accessories under the Jin San Ta brand through its offline stores and online marketing channels; knitted underwear; and jacquard garments. It is also involved in the manufacture of precision metal products, including electrical hardware, electronic hardware, appliance hardware, apparel hardware, furniture hardware, and photovoltaic equipment accessories; and operation of an industry supply chain public platform. In addition, the company engages in real estate and education; business services; wholesale and retail; general trade; leasing; financial services; electricity and heat production and supply; metal products; weaving; testing services; technology promotion and application services; industrial park operation services; warehousing and logistics services; and investment activities. It exports its products to approximately 60 countries and regions, including Europe, America, Japan, and India. Zhejiang Jiaxin Silk Corp.,Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
